@wp_adequacy_irel
     : ∀ (Σ : gFunctors) (invGS0 : invGS Σ) (exampleHGS0 : program_logic.exampleHGS Σ) (R : Type) 
         (t : ITreeDefinition.itree lang.exampleE R) (σ : heap lang.val) (te : Execution R) 
         (Φ : R → iProp Σ) (n : option nat),
         examplelang_irel σ n t te
         → state_interp σ -∗
           wpi.wpi_mask ⊤ t (λ v : R, Φ v) ={⊤,∅}=∗
           ∃ x : Outcome R, ⌜Eqit.eutt eq te {| ITreeDefinition._observe := ITreeDefinition.RetF x |}⌝ ∗
             (let (σ0, s) := x in
              match s with
              | inl (inl v) => |={∅,⊤}=> state_interp σ0 ∗ Φ v
              | inl (inr LastThreadKilled) => |={∅,⊤}=> state_interp σ0
              | inr ub.UbCrash => |={∅,⊤}=> False
              end)

@wp_adequacy_irel
     : forall (Σ : iprop.gFunctors) (invGS0 : fancy_updates.invGS_gen fancy_updates.HasLc Σ)
         (heaplangHGS0 : program_logic.heaplangHGS Σ) (R : Type) (t : ITreeDefinition.itree lang.heaplangE R)
         (σ : gmap.gmap locations.loc (option definition.heap_lang.val)) (te : Execution R)
         (Φ : R -> upred.uPred (iprop.iProp_solution.iResUR Σ)) (n : option nat) (m : step.later_modality),
       heaplang_irel σ n t te ->
       interface.bi_emp_valid
         (interface.bi_wand
            (interface.bi_impl (interface.bi_pure (m = step.Later))
               match n with
               | Some n0 => later_credits.lc n0
               | None => interface.bi_pure False
               end)
            (interface.bi_wand (state.state_interp σ)
               (interface.bi_wand (wpi.wpi_mask base.top t (fun v : R => Φ v))
                  (updates.fupd base.top base.empty
                     (interface.bi_exist
                        (fun x : Outcome R =>
                         interface.bi_sep
                           (interface.bi_pure
                              (Eqit.eutt eq te {| ITreeDefinition._observe := ITreeDefinition.RetF x |}))
                           match x with
                           | TermRet (σ0, TermRet (TermRet v)) =>
                               updates.fupd base.empty base.top (interface.bi_sep (state.state_interp σ0) (Φ v))
                           | TermRet (σ0, TermRet (inr interleaving.LastThreadKilled)) =>
                               updates.fupd base.empty base.top (state.state_interp σ0)
                           | TermRet (σ0, TermUb) => updates.fupd base.empty base.top (interface.bi_pure False)
                           | inr step.StepExhausted => interface.bi_pure (option.is_Some n)
                           end))))))
Axioms:

     : forall (n : nat) (e : language.expr definition.heap_lang) (σ : language.state definition.heap_lang)
         (tp' : list (language.expr definition.heap_lang)) (σ' : language.state definition.heap_lang)
         (κ : list (language.observation definition.heap_lang)) (tx : Terminal definition.heap_lang.val),
       language.nsteps n ((e :: nil)%list, σ) κ (tp', σ') ->
       tp_termination tp' σ' tx ->
       exists (te : Execution definition.heap_lang.val) (x : Outcome definition.heap_lang.val),
         heaplang_eval e (definition.heap_lang.heap σ) (Some n) te /\
         Eqit.eutt eq te {| ITreeDefinition._observe := ITreeDefinition.RetF x |} /\
         (exists σ'0 : gmap.gmap locations.loc (option definition.heap_lang.val),
            match tx with
            | TermRet r => x = TermRet (σ'0, TermRet (TermRet r))
            | TermUb => x = TermRet (σ'0, TermUb)
            end)
